artifact.name: Workspace study
artifact.summary: A component-backed workspace composition with navigator, selected-object workspace, and assistant dock.

candidates.evidence: The artifact composes the canonical workspace regions and carries object.workspace DSDS plugin data.
The artifact also contains a page-level shell and persistent navigation.

observations: Fifteen component instances are present, but several composition colors remain hardcoded.
The prototype registry currently records the visual concern as exploration.
Canonical code already implements PanelShell, PanelGroup, and PanelRegion.
constraints: Do not claim runtime equivalence from Figma alone.
Do not mutate both Figma and code in one operation.
